[Story]
Xiao Chen and his roommate Xiao Zhao share an apartment, and Xiao Chen hopes that Xiao Zhao agrees to let his pet cat live with them, so he does not have to find another place for the cat.

[Question]
How does Xiao Chen convince Xiao Zhao?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Xiao Chen gives examples of other roommates who successfully keep cats in shared apartments.
B. Xiao Chen suggests trying it for a while, if Xiao Zhao does not adapt, he arranges a new place for the cat.
C. He emphasizes that such cooperation makes their relationship more harmonious.
D. Xiao Chen emphasizes that the company of the cat makes the apartment more warm and interesting.
